title: 2.1.37 Combine &&, ||, and !
description: Write one if condition that uses all three logical operators together. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice combining book 2.1.8 'Combining Conditions' (&&, ||, !) after each was practiced separately

steps.title: Declare three variables
steps.instructions: Create hasTicket (true/false), age (a number), and isBlocked (true/false).

steps.title: Combine all three operators
steps.instructions: Write an if statement whose condition uses && to require hasTicket, uses || so age >= 65 or age < 5 also counts as eligible, and uses ! to require isBlocked to be false. For example: (hasTicket && (age < 5 || age >= 65)) && !isBlocked. Log a message when the condition is true, and an else message when it isn't.

requirements.title: && combines with a real variable
requirements.description: if condition uses && together with a named variable, not a hardcoded true/false

requirements.title: || compares the same variable on both sides
requirements.description: if condition uses || between two comparisons on the same variable (a range check, e.g. age < 5 || age >= 65)

requirements.title: ! flips a real variable
requirements.description: if condition uses ! directly on a named variable, not a hardcoded literal

requirements.title: all three combined in one condition
requirements.description: A single if condition uses &&, a same-variable range check with ||, and ! together, not three separate ifs
